title: Catalogue sources around a position
description: Response of GET /api/catalogue (T15): sources of the AllWISE Source Catalog (WISE, NASA/IPAC IRSA) inside a field. Always real catalogue data, never simulated. Positions are the catalogue's own, ICRS degrees, at the catalogue's reference epoch, not corrected for proper motion: a moving object is where the catalogue saw it, not where it is now. `mjd` is the catalogue's own column w1mjdmean, described in IRSA's AllWISE documentation as the mean MJD of the observations used for the entry in W1 (found by search; the Explanatory Supplement was not read, so the exact meaning is unverified here). No proper motion is applied or invented.

service.description: The TAP service the sources were read from.

sources.description: Brightest first (by W1). Empty when status is error or the field holds no source.

w1_mag.description: W1 profile-fit magnitude (column w1mpro), Vega system per IRSA's AllWISE documentation; null when the catalogue has none. Only W1 is fetched.

mjd.description: Catalogue column w1mjdmean (see the description above); null when the catalogue has none.

truncated.description: True when the field holds more sources than were returned (the brightest are kept).
